summary.en-US: Play HLS (.m3u8) streams directly in Firefox instead of downloading them.

description.en-US:
HLS Player opens HTTP Live Streaming (.m3u8) links directly in Firefox instead of downloading them. It offers Seamless mode, optional native video controls, and Display / Ratio settings (Best fit, Fill, Original, Native, 16:9, and 4:3).

The new on-screen Stream Info panel displays live diagnostics including resolution, codec (when provided), displayed FPS, dropped frames, quality level, downloaded bytes, measured fragment throughput with a compact 30-second chart, buffer ahead, and live latency (when available). Toggle it using the info icon or the I key; click outside or press Escape to close.

Playback uses Firefox's native HLS support when available and otherwise the bundled hls.js library. The add-on requires no account and includes no analytics, remote code, or developer-operated service.

privacy_policy.en-US: HLS Player does not collect or transmit personal data, browsing history, stream URLs, playback information, or analytics to the developer. The live Stream Info diagnostics, including throughput history, are calculated and displayed locally in Firefox and are not sent to the developer or a third-party analytics service. Seamless mode, the video-controls preference, and the Display / Ratio preference are stored only in browser.storage.local and are not synchronized or transmitted to the developer.

version.approval_notes: HTTP/HTTPS host access plus webRequest and webRequestBlocking are required to redirect top-level .m3u8 navigations before Firefox treats them as downloads. The listener is restricted to main_frame requests and .m3u8 pathnames. The storage permission stores only local player preferences: Seamless mode, whether native controls are shown, and the selected Display / Ratio mode. hls.js is pinned in package-lock.json and bundled locally; no remote code is executed. Reproduce with Node.js 24, npm ci, then npm run build.

release_notes.en-US: New in 0.4.0: Live Stream Info on-screen display with a 30-second network-throughput graph, displayed FPS, dropped frames, buffer and latency diagnostics, codec and stream quality metadata, and a downloaded-data counter. The translucent panel is compact and closes by clicking outside, pressing Escape, or using the info icon. Includes improved HLS playback diagnostics and retains all existing Display / Ratio and Seamless settings.
